description: Search public tenders and procurement notices published in TED (EU Official Journal S, all EU/EEA countries plus EU-funded procurement such as Serbia): keywords, buyer country, CPV code, contracting authority, awarded supplier, notice type, publication and deadline date ranges and estimated value. Each notice normalized: title, buyer, CPV, procedure, estimated value with currency, lot deadlines, lifecycle stage, winners as published, and the official TED links. Price: 0.005 USDC per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account, no API key); invalid input is refused before payment and a failed run is never charged. Without a payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired. How to call it: get_example {"tool":"tenders_search"}. Same tool over HTTP: https://yruz.one/api/tenders/search?q=software&country=RS&limit=10

country.description: buyer country, ISO code (DE, DEU, RS, SRB ...)

cpv.description: CPV code or prefix, 2-8 digits, e.g. 72 or 72000000

q.description: keywords in the notice text, e.g. cloud software

type.description: competition (calls), result (awards), change (amendments), planning (prior information) or all (default)

value_min.description: estimated procedure value at least (in its own currency)

name: tenders_search
title: YRUZ TenderGraph Search (0.005 USDC)
